# PolicySettings

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Settings that apply to the whole policy. Every field is optional in a
document and has the default shown in the schema.

Appears at: `/policy/settings`.

The registry is empty in this version, so any key is rejected unless `allow_unknown_advanced` is set. |
